samples.xml_description:
<module id="multi_pipe_8bit">
    <description>Design an 8-bit unsigned multiplier using pipelined processing. Implement the design using sequential logic blocks.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal.</input>
        <input id="mul_en_in">Input enable signal for multiplication.</input>
        <input id="mul_a" width_description="[7:0]">Multiplicand input.</input>
        <input id="mul_b" width_description="[7:0]">Multiplier input.</input>
        <output id="mul_en_out">Output enable signal for multiplication result.</output>
        <output id="mul_out" width_description="[15:0]">Product output.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="WIDTH_A">Width of the multiplicand input.</parameter>
        <parameter id="WIDTH_B">Width of the multiplier input.</parameter>
        <parameter id="WIDTH_OUT">Width of the product output.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="mul_en_out_reg">Register to hold the output enable signal.</reg>
        <reg id="mul_a_reg" width_description="[WIDTH_A-1:0]">Register to hold the multiplicand input.</reg>
        <reg id="mul_b_reg" width_description="[WIDTH_B-1:0]">Register to hold the multiplier input.</reg>
        <wire id="temp[0]" width_description="[WIDTH_OUT-1:0]">Wire to hold the first partial product.</wire>
        <wire id="temp[1]" width_description="[WIDTH_OUT-1:0]">Wire to hold the second partial product.</wire>
        <wire id="temp[2]" width_description="[WIDTH_OUT-1:0]">Wire to hold the third partial product.</wire>
        <wire id="temp[3]" width_description="[WIDTH_OUT-1:0]">Wire to hold the fourth partial product.</wire>
        <wire id="temp[4]" width_description="[WIDTH_OUT-1:0]">Wire to hold the fifth partial product.</wire>
        <wire id="temp[5]" width_description="[WIDTH_OUT-1:0]">Wire to hold the sixth partial product.</wire>
        <wire id="temp[6]" width_description="[WIDTH_OUT-1:0]">Wire to hold the seventh partial product.</wire>
        <wire id="temp[7]" width_description="[WIDTH_OUT-1:0]">Wire to hold the eighth partial product.</wire>
        <reg id="sum[0]" width_description="[WIDTH_OUT-1:0]">Register to hold the first partial sum.</reg>
        <reg id="sum[1]" width_description="[WIDTH_OUT-1:0]">Register to hold the second partial sum.</reg>
        <reg id="sum[2]" width_description="[WIDTH_OUT-1:0]">Register to hold the third partial sum.</reg>
        <reg id="sum[3]" width_description="[WIDTH_OUT-1:0]">Register to hold the fourth partial sum.</reg>
        <reg id="sum[4]" width_description="[WIDTH_OUT-1:0]">Register to hold the fifth partial sum.</reg>
        <reg id="sum[5]" width_description="[WIDTH_OUT-1:0]">Register to hold the sixth partial sum.</reg>
        <reg id="sum[6]" width_description="[WIDTH_OUT-1:0]">Register to hold the seventh partial sum.</reg>
        <reg id="sum[7]" width_description="[WIDTH_OUT-1:0]">Register to hold the eighth partial sum.</reg>
        <reg id="mul_out_reg" width_description="[WIDTH_OUT-1:0]">Register to hold the final product output.</reg>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // Sequential logic block for updating the output enable signal
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                mul_en_out_reg <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
                mul_en_out_reg <= {mul_en_out_reg[WIDTH_OUT-2:0], mul_en_in};
            end
        end
        
        // Sequential logic block for updating the multiplicand register
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                mul_a_reg <= 'd0;
            end else begin
                if (mul_en_in) begin
                    mul_a_reg <= mul_a;
                end
            end
        end
        
        // Sequential logic block for updating the multiplier register
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                mul_b_reg <= 'd0;
            end else begin
                if (mul_en_in) begin
                    mul_b_reg <= mul_b;
                end
            end
        end
        
        // Combinational logic block for generating partial products
        genvar i;
        generate
            for (i = 0; i < WIDTH_B; i = i + 1) begin : pp_gen
                assign temp[i] = (mul_b_reg[i]) ? {{(WIDTH_OUT-WIDTH_A){1'b0}}, mul_a_reg} << i : 'd0;
            end
        endgenerate
        
        // Sequential logic block for calculating partial sums
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                sum[0] <= 'd0;
                sum[1] <= 'd0;
                sum[2] <= 'd0;
                sum[3] <= 'd0;
                sum[4] <= 'd0;
                sum[5] <= 'd0;
                sum[6] <= 'd0;
                sum[7] <= 'd0;
            end else begin
                sum[0] <= temp[0];
                sum[1] <= temp[1] + temp[2];
                sum[2] <= temp[3] + temp[4];
                sum[3] <= temp[5] + temp[6];
                sum[4] <= temp[7];
                sum[5] <= 'd0;
                sum[6] <= 'd0;
                sum[7] <= 'd0;
            end
        end
        
        // Sequential logic block for calculating the final product
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                mul_out_reg <= 'd0;
            end else begin
                mul_out_reg <= sum[0] + sum[1] + sum[2] + sum[3] + sum[4] + sum[5] + sum[6] + sum[7];
            end
        end
        
        // Assigning the output product based on the output enable signal
        assign mul_out = (mul_en_out_reg[WIDTH_OUT-1]) ? mul_out_reg : 'd0;
        
        // Assigning the output enable signal
        assign mul_en_out = mul_en_out_reg[WIDTH_OUT-1];
    </implementation>
    
</module>
